verdict.rationale: Algolia's Search REST API covers indexing, search, configuration, rules, and records, and the CLI (docs-2,4,50) wraps these APIs for terminal/CI use, giving strong API-first access. However some dashboard-only features (e.g., visual Merchandising Studio curation, A/B test setup, analytics dashboard comparison mode) are described only as UI actions in docs, with no explicit API/CLI equivalent evidenced, so full UI-API parity isn't confirmed. missing for 10: explicit API endpoints for Merchandising Studio curation/pinning, A/B test creation via API, and dashboard-only scheduling/transformation configuration.
